name: Rubber-band selection and selection cycling
body:
# Rubber-band selection

Left-dragging on empty space draws a rectangle and selects every entity whose projected bounds it touches (Shift adds,
Ctrl removes). Clicking repeatedly on overlapping entities cycles through the hits under the cursor.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27 for box selection (left-drag on empty space, Shift adds). Selection cycling through overlapping entities is a follow-up card.
